title: Effective machine action
statement: Given an optional current state, an optional input symbol, the symbols scanned on the work tapes, and a choice bit, the effective action is the idle action when there is no current state. When there is a current state, it is the machine's transition action for that state, scanned symbols, and choice bit.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Booleans
the current state is either a state of $N$ or absent
the input symbol is either Boolean or absent
each work-tape scanned symbol is either Boolean or absent
